title.narrative: City link Ostend-Banjul ¿ partnership for sustainable city development

description.narrative: The newly found democracy in Gambia has enabled institutional operational independence across all public and private sectors. Thanks to this change, Banjul City Council has a uniquely unprecedented opportunity to be accountable to its electorates and communities, the ability to more effectively and realistically undertake institutional and systemic transformations that will deliver promised development and make lives better for citizens. In this context, it is Banjuls vision to become a more resilient city and the sub-regional hub for commerce and marine related business where people can work, live and enjoy in economic prosperity and security; through its institutional ability to sustainably provide quality services to all stakeholders.
